profile.headline: Software Engineer at SoundCommerce
profile.summary:
I'm probably not a kid anymore...

Work Experience, the abridged version:

- Copy-"Improve"-then-Paste code from www.stackoverflow.com
- Review/Diff every single check-in from other devs
- Compulsive use of VS hotkeys, especially the ones starting with Ctrl+K. (Comment, Format, Surround in, etc...)
- Writing C# code in ways in which would defeat the purpose of having a strongly-typed language via liberal use of anonymous delegates, Expression Trees of ConstructorInfo (cached variety, of course), and dynamic keyword.

Specialties: .NET (C#), ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, MSSQL, javascript (via jQuery, dojo, YUI, MS-AJAX)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
SoundCommerce equips consumer brands with advanced technology, enabling world-class shopper experiences that drive profitable growth.
An Operations Data Platform for consumer brands and retailers, SoundCommerce transforms customer experience through better decisioning across merchandising, supply, fulfillment, delivery, and customer service. Track real-time operational events, profitability and customer lifetime value to answer questions and drive actions fundamental to cross-channel and direct-to-consumer success.
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Kafka · Scala · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) · Google BigQuery

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Mercent Retail
positions.description: Trying to figure it out all over again...

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
"Acquired by CommerceHub (Liberty Interactive Corporation)."

Making sure our .NET SasS Platform never seizes to:
1. Receive more,
2. Validate faster,
3. Normalize as intended,
4. Transform with ease,
5. Load as much we need (or want) and
6. Syndicate quality data
so that we don't make liars out of those on the front lines
all the while making our engineers' lives less complicated than they have to be.

positions.title: Social Software Developer
positions.description: Build Content/Asset Management solution. (ASP.NET MVC, MSSQL, and dojo javascript library)

positions.title: Software Support Engineer
positions.description:
- Scrape competitor websites for BI (via Perl/Regex, sniffing out any weaknesses in their website architecture)
- Provide "If-it-don't-work, you-ain't-going-home" band-aid solutions for mission critical system failures.
- Fetch Data (BI report from Oracle DB, generate product feeds, configure Splunk server to roll up logs, etc.)
